# Pki

The certificates of the fleet, and the rotation of the controller's key and of
the NATS server's certificate. `osapi dsl endpoint get --name pki` shows the
same.

| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Name        | pki                                                                                                          |
| Description | The certificates of the fleet, and the rotation of the controller's key and of the NATS server's certificate |
| Area        | fleet                                                                                                        |
